collection.title: Saab 9-3 Hatchback 2007 to 2012 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Saab 9-3 Hatchback Mk3 2007 to 2012 model requires a 23" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Pinch Tab arm attachment.
